tech.summary: Apple ne confirm kar diya ke China mein Apple Intelligence ki testing 4 November se iOS developer beta mein shuru hogi, aur public release December mein iOS 27.3 ke saath aayegi. Siri, Writing Tools aur Visual Intelligence mein kuch requests ke liye Alibaba ka Qwen model use hoga — lekin nayi Siri AI is waqt China mein nahi aayegi. Pehli wave sirf iPhone par hogi: iPhone 15 Pro/Max, iPhone 16 aur baad ke models, iPhone Air aur iPhone Duo.
tech.title: Apple Intelligence aakhir China pohanch gaya — Alibaba ke Qwen ke saath, testing 4 Nov se

tech.summary: Financial Times ke mutabiq OpenAI ne apni latest funding round ka target $10 billion kam kar ke taqreeban $20 billion kar diya hai, aur desired valuation $1.4 trillion se gir kar $1.25 trillion ho gayi. Investors ko commit karne ki Friday deadline thi, lekin 'first close' $20 billion se kam hone ki umeed hai — kuch investors ne allocations ghata di. UAE consortium (jis mein MGX shamil hai) sab se bara participant hone ki umeed hai. Nasdaq Jumme ko 2.9% gira, aur apne 6 Oct ke peak se 7.8% neeche hai.
tech.title: OpenAI ne funding target $10B ghata diya — $20B par, valuation $1.25 trillion

tech.summary: Alphabet ke shares ek din mein 12% se zyada gir gaye — market value $3.97 trillion se $3.46 trillion tak aa gayi, taqreeban $500 billion ka wipeout, Wall Street history ka doosra sab se bara one-day drop. Wajah: Google ka AI Mode aur AI summaries users ko direct jawab de dete hain, to sponsored links par clicks kam ho rahe hain — search ad revenue growth 19% se gir kar 12% reh gayi, aur free cash flow -$9.1 billion ho gaya. Google ke CBO ne khud mana ke AI Mode ads ki kamai kha raha hai.
tech.title: Google ki apni AI ne Alphabet ko $500B ka nuqsan pohanchaya — ek din mein 12% crash

tech.summary: Google ne Gemini mein in-chat file editing launch kar di: ab documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, slides, Markdown aur code files chat ke andar hi create, preview aur edit ho sakenge — full-screen mein khud type karo, kisi text ko highlight kar ke Gemini se sawal poochho, ya use refine karne ko kaho. PDF editing web aur mobile dono par hai; baaqi formats filhal sirf web par. Ye April mein launch hui file-generation feature ka agla step hai, aur ChatGPT/Copilot ke barabar lane ki koshish hai.
tech.title: Gemini ab poora office ban gaya — Docs, Sheets, PDFs chat ke andar hi edit karo

tech.summary: DeepSeek ne 31 Oct ko apni Harness team ka 'super-agent' system dikhaya: jab team members group chats mein software issues report karte hain, to system khud defect pehchan kar use reproduce aur fix karne ki koshish karta hai — bina directly tag kiye. Design two-layer architecture, event-driven workflows aur ek external watchdog par hai. Ye AI agents ko sirf prompt ka jawab dene se aage, team workflows mein autonomous teammate banane ki taraf ek qadam hai.
tech.title: DeepSeek ka 'super-agent' — AI khud bug dhoondhe, fix kare, bina tag kiye

tech.summary: Xiaomi ne 800-million-parameter document understanding model Xiaomi-OCR-0 open-source kar diya — documents parhna, images analyze karna aur sawalon ke jawab, ek hi halka model mein. Isi hafte 18 Chinese humanoid robotics companies listing ki taraf barh rahi hain, aur 2026 ki pehli half mein global humanoid shipments ka 97% se zyada China se aaya. Beijing AI Plus Conference mein Tsinghua ke academician ne kaha ke Chinese chips ki asal rukawat hardware nahi, software ecosystem hai.
tech.title: China ka AI shift: chote models, robots aur 97% humanoid shipments

pakistan.summary: Fakhar Zaman ne 99 balls par 127 runs ki commanding innings kheli — taqreeban 3 saal baad pehli ODI century, 12th overall — aur Pakistan ne Gaddafi Stadium Lahore mein Sri Lanka ko 3 wickets se hara kar home tri-series trophy jeet li. Sri Lanka ne 325/8 banaye (Kamindu Mendis 131), Pakistan ne 326 ka target 48.3 overs mein 329/7 par poora kiya — ODI final mein joint-highest successful chase. Babar Azam 5-ball duck par out hue, lekin Saad Baig (74), Arafat Minhas aur Hassan Nawaz ki 94-run partnership ne match palat diya.
pakistan.title: Fakhar ka 127 — Pakistan ne 326 chase kar ke tri-series trophy jeet li, 2008 ke baad pehli baar

pakistan.summary: Hukoomat ne diesel ki qeemat Rs2.29 per litre barha kar Rs402.96 kar di, jab ke petrol Rs377.91 par unchanged raha — nayi qeematein 31 Oct se 2 Nov tak lagu hain. Ye doosre din bhi petrol unchanged raha; diesel ek din pehle bhi 85 paisa barha tha aur Rs400 cross kar gaya tha. Petrol par Rs114 aur diesel par Rs100 per litre taxes/duties barqarar hain. JI chief ne levy khatam karne ka mutalba kiya hai, warna mid-November mein Islamabad march ki dhamki di hai.
pakistan.title: Diesel Rs2.29 mehenga (Rs402.96), petrol Rs377.91 par unchanged — 31 Oct se 2 Nov tak

pakistan.summary: November ke liye Ogra ne LPG Rs14.73 per kg mehenga kar diya — official rate Rs294/kg, 11.8kg cylinder Rs3,470 (Rs173 izafa). Lekin open market mein LPG Rs630/kg tak bik raha hai, company franchises Rs400/kg le rahe hain. Wajah: Iran border band honay se shortage — 70% LPG Iran se aata tha. LPG marketers ne dhamki di hai ke agar nayi policy mein private sector ko side-line kiya gaya to 16 Nov se strike hogi.
pakistan.title: LPG open market mein official rate se double — Rs630/kg tak, cylinder Rs3,470 official

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Medical Association ne 1–2 November ko mulk-gir strike ka elan kiya hai: public aur private facilities mein OPDs, elective surgeries aur routine diagnostics band rahenge, lekin government hospitals ki emergency services chalti rahengi. Mutalbat: FBR taxation aur clinics par mandatory POS system ka khatma, doctors ke khilaf criminal FIRs ka khatma (baghair medical board assessment), aur workplace security. YDA Sindh aur PMA Punjab ne bhi support ka elan kar diya hai.
pakistan.title: Aaj aur kal doctors ki mulk-gir strike — OPDs, elective surgeries, diagnostics band; emergency khuli

pakistan.summary: Election Commission ne gender gap kam karne ke liye Kasur (Punjab) aur Qamber-Shahdadkot (Sindh) mein pilot project shuru kiya hai: November mein data collection, December 2026 se February 2027 tak voter registration. Door-to-door visits, awareness campaigns aur Nadra Mobile Registration Vans ke zariye 115,689 khawateen Kasur mein aur 59,156 Qamber-Shahdadkot mein register karne ka target hai.
pakistan.title: ECP ka voter registration pilot — Kasur aur Qamber-Shahdadkot mein khawateen ki registration barhane ka plan

pakistan.summary: IAEA ki report ke mutabiq Pakistan ne nuclear (isotope-based) techniques se groundwater track karne ki salahiyat mazboot kar li hai — recharge sources, paani ki umar aur contamination pathways ka pata chal sakta hai. Pinstech ab region ki sab se advanced isotope analysis facilities mein se ek hai, 12 labs ke saath. Indus Plain, Quetta Valley aur Cholistan Desert mein recharge rates aur pollution pathways ke reliable estimates mil chuke hain, jo over-extraction aur salinity ko jaldi pakarne mein madad denge.
pakistan.title: Nuclear science se Pakistan ki groundwater tracking behtar — Indus Plain se Cholistan tak
